title: TRAINEE/JUNIOR IRRIGATION DESIGNER
abstract: Trainee Irrigation Designer/Draftsperson to join our Perth team and work towards becoming a Certified Irrigation Designer.
bullets: Be part of a great team
Incredible opportunity to build a career
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as an Irrigation Designer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
Do you have experience using AutoCAD 2D?
content_text:
About the role
In order to support our ongoing expansion, we are looking for a Trainee Irrigation Designer/Draftsperson to join our Perth team. The successful applicant will be trained under the mentorship of the team and work towards becoming a Certified Irrigation Designer. We are looking for someone who has an interest in the environment, sustainable water management and has a willingness to learn and grow with us.
Key responsibilities
- Continue to develop your AutoCAD & irrigation design skills.
- Develop and maintain your product awareness, knowledge and specification updates.
- Support on irrigation design projects and tasks, business and administrative duties as needed.
- General contract administration.
- Attend site visits as required.
- Attend any training or professional development required for your role as reasonably required.
About you
- Have recent and moderate-level AutoCAD software experience.
- Experience in irrigation or water management would be beneficial.
- Be willing to undertake the training required to gain the Certified Irrigation Designer qualification.
- Naturally have a high attention to detail, able to multi-task and prioritise your workload.
- Be punctual, presentable, and available when dealing with our clients in person or remotely.
- Hold a current driver's licence and have your own eligible working rights for Australia.
About us
CADSULT is an irrigation design and water management consulting firm with more than 30 years of experience. We deliver projects across Australia and internationally with specialist areas being sports fields, golf courses and commercial landscapes irrigation design and consulting. We have a close-knit team of enthusiastic individuals who are passionate about efficient use of water, implemented through our expertise in irrigation design and consulting, ensuring we deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients around the globe. We are proud of the culture we have created, and our flexible work environment allows everyone to maintain a healthy work life balance whilst meeting the needs of our clients.
